notes: Assigned original Study 2 and page are located. The descriptions do not specify the contrast or whether latency is controlled. Candidate printed PSD-slope tests on p. 56: control versus average of avoid-race/use-race F(1, 68) = 5.52, p < .02 (the authors' primary prediction); avoid-race versus control F(1, 68) = 5.24, p < .03; use-race versus control F(1, 68) = 3.17, p < .08; avoid-race versus use-race F(1, 68) = 0.19, p < .66. With mean latency covaried: control versus experimental F(1, 67) = 5.90, p < .02; avoid-race versus use-race F(1, 67) = 0.51, p < .70. These candidates are not selected using row order, replication identity, or numeric matching. Printed metric is F; no conversion. Table 2 supplies mutually exclusive condition counts: control 24, use race 25, avoid race 22; 24 + 25 + 22 = 71 participants in the full Study 2 condition model. This is candidate model N, not a resolved row-specific analytic N. No participant exclusions are stated in Study 2; spectral analysis removes trial-type, accuracy, and trial-number effects and excludes log frequencies greater than zero. The full-model N does not resolve which test is intended. Rendered PDF pp. 8–9 inspected for layout. Unassigned fields/sides are placeholders only.
